description: Curated primary-source research map for Continual Decision Model. Evidence levels describe reading depth, not independent reproduction.
year_convention: Year of the cited public edition or the initial release explicitly noted in evidence_location; preprint and venue years can differ.

papers.title: Long Short-Term Memory
papers.evidence_location: Original paper hosted by the authors' institution, PDF page 1 abstract.
papers.mechanism: Gated memory cells preserve error flow across long temporal dependencies.
papers.demonstrated_scope: Synthetic tasks with long delays and varied input representations.
papers.cdm_relevance: Establishes the foundational gated-state ancestor.

papers.title: Neural Turing Machines
papers.mechanism: A neural controller accesses external memory through differentiable attention.
papers.demonstrated_scope: Copying, sorting, and associative recall.
papers.cdm_relevance: Establishes learned read-write memory as architectural prior art.

papers.title: Hybrid computing using a neural network with dynamic external memory
papers.evidence_location: Original paper PDF mirrored at https://gwern.net/doc/reinforcement-learning/model-free/2016-graves.pdf, pages 1-4; publisher page failed to load.
papers.mechanism: Differentiable memory combines content lookup, temporal links, and usage-based allocation.
papers.demonstrated_scope: Synthetic question answering, graph reasoning, and reinforcement-learning block puzzles.
papers.cdm_relevance: Precedes structured memory organization and stored plans.

papers.title: Attention Is All You Need
papers.evidence_location: arXiv abstract and bibliographic metadata, v7.
papers.mechanism: Attention-based encoder-decoder sequence transduction replaces recurrent sequence processing.
papers.demonstrated_scope: Machine translation and English constituency parsing.
papers.cdm_relevance: Establishes a content-addressable interaction baseline.

papers.title: Relational recurrent neural networks
papers.evidence_location: https://arxiv.org/html/1806.01822v2, Section 3 architecture and Sections 5-6 evidence.
papers.mechanism: Multi-head attention lets recurrent memory slots interact before gated updates.
papers.demonstrated_scope: Partially observed reinforcement learning, program evaluation, and language modeling.
papers.cdm_relevance: Directly precedes relational persistent workspaces.

papers.title: Transformer-XL: Attentive Language Models Beyond a Fixed-Length Context
papers.evidence_location: arXiv abstract, v3; recurrence details also cross-checked in RMT Section 3.
papers.mechanism: Segment recurrence reuses hidden representations with relative positional encoding.
papers.demonstrated_scope: Long-context language modeling across five established datasets.
papers.cdm_relevance: Separates activation reuse from compact state rewriting.

papers.title: Transformers are RNNs: Fast Autoregressive Transformers with Linear Attention
papers.mechanism: Kernelized attention admits an iterative recurrent computation.
papers.demonstrated_scope: Sequence modeling and autoregressive efficiency experiments.
papers.cdm_relevance: Shows that attention and recurrence are overlapping computational descriptions.

papers.title: Efficiently Modeling Long Sequences with Structured State Spaces
papers.evidence_location: arXiv abstract, v3; first posted 2021, ICLR 2022.
papers.mechanism: Structured state-space parameterization enables efficient long-sequence computation.
papers.demonstrated_scope: Long Range Arena, sequential vision, and sequence generation.
papers.cdm_relevance: Motivates principled dynamics for persistent state.

papers.title: Linear Transformers Are Secretly Fast Weight Programmers
papers.mechanism: Fast-weight programming uses delta corrections and learned update rates for associative memory.
papers.demonstrated_scope: Synthetic retrieval, machine translation, and language modeling.
papers.cdm_relevance: Establishes prior art for editable matrix memory.

papers.title: Recurrent Memory Transformer
papers.mechanism: Memory tokens carry learned representations across segments with cross-segment backpropagation.
papers.demonstrated_scope: Algorithmic memory tasks and language modeling.
papers.cdm_relevance: Provides a close persistent-workspace baseline.

papers.title: Temporal Latent Bottleneck: Synthesis of Fast and Slow Processing Mechanisms in Sequence Learning
papers.mechanism: A fast Transformer stream exchanges information with a slower recurrent latent bottleneck.
papers.demonstrated_scope: Visual perception, sequential decision-making, and long-range tasks.
papers.cdm_relevance: Directly precedes two-timescale attention-recurrence architectures.

papers.title: Block-Recurrent Transformers
papers.evidence_location: https://arxiv.org/html/2203.07852v3, Section 3 methods and Section 4 comparisons.
papers.mechanism: Attention and gated state updates implement recurrence over token blocks.
papers.demonstrated_scope: Long-sequence language modeling on books, papers, and source code.
papers.cdm_relevance: Directly precedes Transformer recurrence over persistent state vectors.

papers.title: A Modern Self-Referential Weight Matrix That Learns to Modify Itself
papers.evidence_location: PMLR ICML 2022 abstract and bibliographic record.
papers.mechanism: A self-referential matrix learns delta-rule modifications to its own weights.
papers.demonstrated_scope: Supervised few-shot learning and multitask reinforcement learning.
papers.cdm_relevance: Directly precedes learned self-modification mechanisms.

papers.title: Mamba: Linear-Time Sequence Modeling with Selective State Spaces
papers.mechanism: Input-dependent state-space parameters select which information propagates.
papers.demonstrated_scope: Language, audio, and genomics sequence modeling.
papers.cdm_relevance: Provides selective recurrent updates for incoming events.

papers.title: Retentive Network: A Successor to Transformer for Large Language Models
papers.mechanism: Retention supports parallel, recurrent, and chunkwise recurrent computation.
papers.demonstrated_scope: Language-model scaling and inference efficiency.
papers.cdm_relevance: Separates training computation from streaming deployment.

papers.title: Gated Linear Attention Transformers with Hardware-Efficient Training
papers.mechanism: Data-dependent gating extends hardware-aware matrix-state linear attention.
papers.demonstrated_scope: Moderate-scale language modeling and length generalization.
papers.cdm_relevance: Makes memory traffic part of architectural comparison.

papers.title: Transformers are SSMs: Generalized Models and Efficient Algorithms Through Structured State Space Duality
papers.mechanism: Structured state-space duality connects recurrence and attention through semiseparable matrices.
papers.demonstrated_scope: Efficient core computation and language modeling.
papers.cdm_relevance: Provides a strong scan-friendly recurrent baseline.

papers.title: Griffin: Mixing Gated Linear Recurrences with Local Attention for Efficient Language Models
papers.mechanism: Gated linear recurrence combines with bounded local attention.
papers.demonstrated_scope: Language-model scaling and inference comparisons.
papers.cdm_relevance: Directly tests the proposed attention-plus-recurrence starting point.

papers.title: Parallelizing Linear Transformers with the Delta Rule over Sequence Length
papers.mechanism: Compact WY representations enable chunkwise training of delta-rule matrix recurrence.
papers.demonstrated_scope: 1.3B language models, retrieval, and attention hybrids.
papers.cdm_relevance: Connects expressive memory editing to scalable training.

papers.title: Gated Delta Networks: Improving Mamba2 with Delta Rule
papers.mechanism: Adaptive decay complements targeted delta-rule correction.
papers.demonstrated_scope: Language modeling, retrieval, extrapolation, and hybrid architectures.
papers.cdm_relevance: Provides an editable-memory baseline with practical kernels.

papers.title: Kimi Linear: An Expressive, Efficient Attention Architecture
papers.mechanism: Channel-wise KDA recurrence is interleaved with global latent attention.
papers.demonstrated_scope: 48B-total, 3B-active models with language and post-training comparisons.
papers.cdm_relevance: Establishes a larger-scale hybrid precedent.

papers.title: RWKV-7 "Goose" with Expressive Dynamic State Evolution
papers.mechanism: Generalized delta updates use vector-valued controls for state evolution.
papers.demonstrated_scope: Language modeling and formal state-tracking analysis.
papers.cdm_relevance: Provides another expressive fixed-state recurrent family.

papers.title: Gated DeltaNet-2: Decoupling Erase and Write in Linear Attention
papers.evidence_location: https://arxiv.org/html/2605.22791v1, Sections 2-3 and Section 4 throughput comparison.
papers.mechanism: Independent channel-wise erase and write gates refine recurrent association editing.
papers.demonstrated_scope: 1.3B models trained on 100B tokens and retrieval comparisons.
papers.cdm_relevance: Bounds novelty claims about separate forgetting and writing.

papers.title: Mamba-3: Improved Sequence Modeling using State Space Principles
papers.mechanism: Improved discretization, complex dynamics, and MIMO updates increase recurrent expressivity.
papers.demonstrated_scope: State tracking, retrieval, language modeling, and kernel efficiency.
papers.cdm_relevance: Tests dynamics quality alongside actual decoding cost.

papers.title: How Linear Attention Remembers
papers.mechanism: Causal interventions separate recurrent writes, stored state, and read pathways.
papers.demonstrated_scope: Controlled recall in pretrained GLA, GDN, and selected hybrids.
papers.cdm_relevance: Motivates separate state and cache interventions.

papers.title: Switching Linear Attention
papers.mechanism: Online expectation-maximization creates dynamically selected recurrent mixture components.
papers.demonstrated_scope: Associative recall, in-context language learning, and language modeling.
papers.cdm_relevance: Provides a neighbor for partitioned or specialized state proposals.

papers.title: Adaptive Computation Time for Recurrent Neural Networks
papers.evidence_location: arXiv abstract, revision v6; first submitted 2016.
papers.mechanism: A differentiable recurrent computation mechanism learns how many internal steps to perform between input and output.
papers.demonstrated_scope: Synthetic algorithmic tasks and character-level language modeling.
papers.cdm_relevance: Historical foundation for adaptive internal depth; does not establish autonomous ongoing activity selection.

papers.title: Metacontrol for Adaptive Imagination-Based Optimization
papers.mechanism: An RL metacontroller chooses both the number of internal simulations and the predictive expert used at each iteration.
papers.demonstrated_scope: Decision-making with nonlinear dynamics, optimizing task loss together with computation cost.
papers.cdm_relevance: Prior art for selecting what to compute, beyond learning when to stop.

papers.title: Universal Transformers
papers.evidence_location: arXiv abstract, v3; first submitted 2018, ICLR 2019.
papers.mechanism: Shared self-attentive transformations recur across depth, with dynamic halting for individual positions.
papers.demonstrated_scope: Algorithmic tasks, language understanding, language modeling, and machine translation.
papers.cdm_relevance: Direct prior art for combining attention, recurrence, and adaptive computation.

papers.title: An Investigation of Model-Free Planning
papers.evidence_location: HTML v2, Sections 2.1-2.2, 3, and 4.1; abstract author list.
papers.mechanism: Deep Repeated ConvLSTM preserves recurrent state between observations and performs multiple internal updates per environment step.
papers.demonstrated_scope: Combinatorial planning domains including Sokoban, Boxworld, Gridworld, and MiniPacman; selected Atari games.
papers.cdm_relevance: Essential baseline for combining temporal persistence and internal computation without a hand-designed planner.

papers.title: PonderNet: Learning to Ponder
papers.mechanism: Learns the number of computational steps while balancing prediction accuracy, computational cost, and generalization.
papers.demonstrated_scope: Synthetic extrapolation and reasoning tasks, plus question answering.
papers.cdm_relevance: A stopping-policy baseline; stopping an existing computation is narrower than selecting the next useful activity.

papers.title: Thinker: Learning to Plan and Act
papers.evidence_location: arXiv abstract and author project summary https://stephen-c.com/projects/thinker/. Additional inspected record: arXiv v2 abstract, 26 October 2023.
papers.mechanism: Additional actions let an RL agent interact with a learned world model and learn its planning behavior.
papers.demonstrated_scope: Sokoban and Atari 2600.
papers.cdm_relevance: A direct baseline for learned internal action selection; world-model interaction is already an established research direction.

papers.title: Training Large Language Models to Reason in a Continuous Latent Space
papers.evidence_location: arXiv abstract, v4; first submitted 2024, accepted to COLM 2025.
papers.mechanism: Coconut feeds the last hidden state back as the next input embedding instead of decoding every intermediate step into words.
papers.demonstrated_scope: Logical reasoning tasks requiring search, with reported accuracy-efficiency improvements over chain-of-thought.
papers.cdm_relevance: A route to nonverbal intermediate computation; distinct from keeping cognitive state across environmental events.

papers.title: Real-Time Execution of Action Chunking Flow Policies
papers.mechanism: RTC generates the next action chunk during execution, preserving committed actions and filling the remainder.
papers.demonstrated_scope: Twelve dynamic Kinetix tasks and six real-world bimanual manipulation tasks.
papers.cdm_relevance: A concrete asynchronous action interface; continuous actuation and rapid response to new evidence require separate measurements.

papers.title: Continuous Thought Machines
papers.evidence_location: Official Sakana report https://pub.sakana.ai/ctm/, Method and experiment sections; arXiv v4 abstract.
papers.mechanism: Internal ticks update neuron-specific temporal models; synchronization of neural activity supplies representations for observation and prediction.
papers.demonstrated_scope: Image classification, mazes, parity, sorting, and other reasoning demonstrations with adaptive computation.
papers.cdm_relevance: Treats internal dynamics as a computational representation; a useful alternative to ordinary looped blocks.

papers.title: Scaling up Test-Time Compute with Latent Reasoning: A Recurrent Depth Approach
papers.mechanism: A shared recurrent block expands latent computation at inference without requiring longer verbal reasoning traces.
papers.demonstrated_scope: A 3.5-billion-parameter language model trained on 800 billion tokens, evaluated on reasoning benchmarks.
papers.cdm_relevance: Evidence that recurrent latent depth can scale beyond tiny puzzle networks; not evidence of lifelong online autonomy.

papers.title: Less is More: Recursive Reasoning with Tiny Networks
papers.mechanism: A small two-layer recursive network simplifies the hierarchical reasoning approach.
papers.demonstrated_scope: ARC-AGI-1 and ARC-AGI-2 puzzle evaluation with a seven-million-parameter model.
papers.cdm_relevance: Motivates testing whether additional architectural hierarchy earns its complexity under matched conditions.

papers.title: Hierarchical Reasoning Model
papers.evidence_location: arXiv abstract, v4 dated 2026-09-30; first submitted 2025.
papers.mechanism: Two interacting recurrent modules operate at different update frequencies for abstract and detailed processing.
papers.demonstrated_scope: Task-trained Sudoku, maze, and ARC reasoning with a compact network.
papers.cdm_relevance: A candidate hierarchy to compare against simpler recurrence; puzzle results do not establish general continual intelligence.

papers.title: T^2MLR: Transformer with Temporal Middle-Layer Recurrence
papers.mechanism: A cached middle-layer representation from the previous token enters an earlier layer at the next token.
papers.demonstrated_scope: Language pretraining, multihop reasoning, and a reported retrofit of a pretrained 1.7-billion-parameter model.
papers.cdm_relevance: Direct prior art for carrying intermediate computation across decoding steps with localized recurrence.

papers.title: Learning to Select Computations in Recurrent Neural Circuits
papers.evidence_location: Author repository README https://github.com/SixingChen028/recurrent-meta-reasoning; paper full text was inaccessible in this review.
papers.mechanism: Official implementations use recurrent actor-critic networks for computation-selection case studies.
papers.demonstrated_scope: Gaze-based choice and planning, plus comparisons with recorded neural dynamics.
papers.cdm_relevance: Connects computation selection to learned recurrent dynamics; retain as a conceptual neighbor pending full-text review.

papers.title: BDH-CQ: In-Context Learning with Recurrent Latent Reasoning
papers.mechanism: Demonstrations update recurrent contextual memory; a separate latent workspace subsequently iterates to answer a query.
papers.demonstrated_scope: Public ARC-AGI-1 and controlled ARC-like tasks; detailed update rules and training recipe remain proprietary.
papers.cdm_relevance: Direct neighbor for memory-plus-reasoning designs; its sequential ingestion and query interface differs from ongoing asynchronous decision-making.

papers.title: Real-Time Execution with Autoregressive Policies
papers.mechanism: Tokenization horizon adjustment and constrained decoding support asynchronous autoregressive action execution.
papers.demonstrated_scope: Simulated and real-world comparisons with corresponding flow-matching policies.
papers.cdm_relevance: Real-time requirements do not uniquely determine the output decoder family; compare complete execution systems.

papers.title: Learning Native Continuation for Action Chunking Flow Policies
papers.evidence_location: arXiv abstract, v2; RSS 2026 acceptance stated on the paper page.
papers.mechanism: Legato trains flow policies with partially known action sequences and randomized continuation schedules.
papers.demonstrated_scope: Five real-world manipulation tasks, evaluating trajectory smoothness and completion time.
papers.cdm_relevance: Shows why asynchronous continuation should inform training, rather than only deployment scheduling.

papers.title: FASTER: Rethinking Real-Time Flow VLAs
papers.mechanism: A horizon-aware flow schedule prioritizes near-term actions, combined with streaming execution.
papers.demonstrated_scope: Real robots including a dynamic table-tennis task; evaluates reaction latency.
papers.cdm_relevance: Sharpens evaluation around event-to-action response, beyond smoothness and inference throughput.

papers.title: Finding the Time to Think: Learning Planning Budgets in Real-Time RL
papers.evidence_location: HTML Sections 1-3, 7, and 8; page identifies version of 2026-08-24.
papers.mechanism: A learned gate selects planning budgets for a frozen MCTS planner while a fast policy acts as the environment advances.
papers.demonstrated_scope: Five real-time games and asynchronous deployment on separate agent and environment GPUs.
papers.cdm_relevance: Direct prior art for time-aware computation allocation; joint planner training and learned dynamics are explicit extensions.

papers.title: Looped Actor: Depth-Recurrent Reasoning Models for Reinforcement Learning
papers.mechanism: A shared Transformer block refines policy latents until consecutive action distributions meet a predefined KL-stability threshold.
papers.demonstrated_scope: Twenty-two tasks in six environments covering online and offline RL, puzzles, and robotic control.
papers.cdm_relevance: Closest baseline for adaptive depth in policies; threshold-based stopping is not direct optimization of computation value.

papers.title: Active Perception
papers.evidence_location: Indexed original MS-CIS-88-24 report title page and body passage on active-sensing feedback and local/global models; direct PDF fetch blocked. Mechanism corroborated in author's 2017 retrospective introduction; no method-level comparison relies on this excerpt alone.
papers.mechanism: Controls data acquisition using interpreted evidence and task-dependent models.
papers.demonstrated_scope: Conceptual sensor-control account; no quantitative benchmark claim used here.
papers.cdm_relevance: Foundation for selecting observations rather than only consuming streams.

papers.title: Principles of metareasoning
papers.evidence_location: Publisher-indexed abstract; year and authors corroborated by Stuart Russell's Berkeley publications page. Direct publisher fetch returned 403.
papers.mechanism: Provides a decision-theoretic basis for selecting computational actions.
papers.demonstrated_scope: Foundational formulation; no specific benchmark claim used here.
papers.cdm_relevance: Conceptual foundation for learned internal action selection.

papers.title: Principles and Applications of Continual Computation
papers.evidence_location: Abstract, introduction, Sections 2-4; author-hosted manuscript pp. 1-9.
papers.mechanism: Allocates resources to possible future problems using expected value of precomputation.
papers.demonstrated_scope: Analytical allocation policies; diagnostic reasoning and media-transmission applications are described.
papers.cdm_relevance: Direct precedent for proactive computation and caching partial results.

papers.title: D* Lite
papers.evidence_location: Author abstract and linked AAAI paper metadata; mechanism and demonstrated scope are limited to the author abstract.
papers.mechanism: Adapts incremental heuristic search to navigation with newly discovered terrain.
papers.demonstrated_scope: Goal-directed navigation and mapping; analysis and experiments.
papers.cdm_relevance: Comparator for persistent planning as evidence arrives.

papers.title: Lifelong Planning A*
papers.evidence_location: Author abstract and linked manuscript, Overview and Sections 2-3. Manuscript copy dated 24 May 2005; journal citation 2004.
papers.mechanism: Reuses unchanged search structure and repairs inconsistent results after graph changes.
papers.demonstrated_scope: Changing-graph shortest paths; route and symbolic planning.
papers.cdm_relevance: Key novelty boundary for selective revision of ongoing deliberation.

papers.title: A Real-Time Iteration Scheme for Nonlinear Optimization in Optimal Feedback Control
papers.evidence_location: Publisher abstract and author-uploaded ResearchGate PDF, Sections 1-2, pp. 1714-1718; the one-iteration scheme is described in Section 1.2.
papers.mechanism: Advances feedback control with one Newton-type update per optimization problem.
papers.demonstrated_scope: Contractivity and optimality-loss analysis; numerical kite-control example.
papers.cdm_relevance: Precedent for carrying optimization progress through ongoing control.

papers.title: Selecting Computations: Theory and Applications
papers.evidence_location: arXiv v1 abstract and authors; comments identify UAI 2012.
papers.mechanism: Frames computation selection as Bayesian selection; develops sampling bounds and approximations.
papers.demonstrated_scope: One-shot decision problems and Go.
papers.cdm_relevance: Evaluate computation by resulting decision improvement.

papers.title: Metareasoning for Planning Under Uncertainty
papers.evidence_location: IJCAI paper abstract and introduction, p. 1601; formalization and BRTDP claims limited to the inspected abstract.
papers.mechanism: Models costly planning while environmental state can change.
papers.demonstrated_scope: MDP analysis and approximate BRTDP-based procedures.
papers.cdm_relevance: Precedent for charging deliberation against environmental time.

papers.title: Dual Control for Approximate Bayesian Reinforcement Learning
papers.mechanism: Approximate Bayesian dual control trades present control against learning dynamics.
papers.demonstrated_scope: Simulated systems; regression, Gaussian-process, and neural-network examples.
papers.cdm_relevance: Actions in scientific experiments can also be informative probes.

papers.title: Revisiting active perception
papers.evidence_location: Introduction and Section 2; online publication 15 February 2017, volume 42 (2018), pp. 177-196.
papers.mechanism: Organizes purposeful sensing by what, how, when, and where.
papers.demonstrated_scope: Author retrospective and conceptual synthesis across perception research.
papers.cdm_relevance: Helps define CDM's learned perceptual decisions.

papers.title: Strategy selection as rational metareasoning
papers.evidence_location: Author manuscript abstract and introduction, pp. 1-4; publication year verified with Princeton institutional record.
papers.mechanism: Learns strategy-performance predictions for cost-benefit selection.
papers.demonstrated_scope: Human strategy-choice modeling, comparisons, and four reported new experiments.
papers.cdm_relevance: Motivates competence-sensitive allocation of internal effort.

papers.title: Learning model-based planning from scratch
papers.evidence_location: Primary arXiv abstract and bibliographic record, 19 July 2017.
papers.mechanism: Learns variable imagination steps, accumulated plan context, and navigation among imagined states with computation costs.
papers.demonstrated_scope: Continuous control and discrete maze tasks.
papers.cdm_relevance: Close predecessor for learned management of deliberation.

papers.title: Imagination-Augmented Agents for Deep Reinforcement Learning
papers.evidence_location: Initial preprint 2017; inspected v2 dated 14 February 2018, Sections 1-3; experiment domains verified from abstract, introduction, and contents. Authors from arXiv metadata.
papers.mechanism: Encodes imagined trajectories and combines them with a direct policy path.
papers.demonstrated_scope: Sokoban and MiniPacman, including imperfect-model experiments.
papers.cdm_relevance: Precedent for learned interpretation of model-based imagination.

papers.title: Learning to select computations
papers.evidence_location: Version 3, 7 August 2018; abstract and introduction; experiment topics verified in contents and abstract. Original preprint 2017.
papers.mechanism: Bayesian metalevel policy search uses value-of-information structure.
papers.demonstrated_scope: Stopping, allocation between options, planning, and emergency-management scenario.
papers.cdm_relevance: A learned scheduling baseline; include metareasoning overhead.

papers.title: Metareasoning in uncertain environments: a meta-BAMDP framework
papers.evidence_location: Initial preprint 2024; inspected v2 dated 3 February 2025, abstract and introduction. Section topics verified in contents.
papers.mechanism: Extends metareasoning to unknown reward and transition distributions.
papers.demonstrated_scope: Approximation theorems and Bernoulli-bandit applications.
papers.cdm_relevance: Separates uncertainty about computation from uncertainty about dynamics.

papers.title: When to Plan: Learning to Select Between Reactive Control and Deliberative Planning
papers.mechanism: Learns uncertainty-conditioned selection of reactive control or planning horizons.
papers.demonstrated_scope: Navigation and motion tasks; supplied accurate model, A*, depth-cost proxy, open-loop option execution.
papers.cdm_relevance: Close comparator for learned timing and computational allocation.

papers.title: Overcoming catastrophic forgetting in neural networks
papers.evidence_location: arXiv:1612.00796v2, abstract; first preprint 2016, journal publication 2017
papers.mechanism: Reduces updates to weights important for previously learned tasks.
papers.demonstrated_scope: Sequential MNIST-derived tasks and Atari games.
papers.cdm_relevance: Parameter retention must be assessed separately from context retention.

papers.title: Using Fast Weights to Attend to the Recent Past
papers.mechanism: Decaying outer-product memory augments a slower recurrent network.
papers.demonstrated_scope: Associative retrieval, visual recognition, and memory-dependent reinforcement learning.
papers.cdm_relevance: Precedent for fast associative state and interacting timescales.

papers.title: Learning to reinforcement learn
papers.mechanism: Recurrent dynamics learn a learning algorithm through outer-loop reinforcement learning.
papers.demonstrated_scope: Seven proof-of-concept meta-reinforcement-learning experiments.
papers.cdm_relevance: Distinguishes learned adaptation dynamics from online weight changes.

papers.title: RL²: Fast Reinforcement Learning via Slow Reinforcement Learning
papers.mechanism: Outer-loop reinforcement learning trains a recurrent inner adaptation procedure.
papers.demonstrated_scope: Bandits, finite MDPs, and vision-based navigation.
papers.cdm_relevance: Cross-episode persistence and behavioral adaptation with frozen weights are established.

papers.title: Gradient Episodic Memory for Continual Learning
papers.evidence_location: https://arxiv.org/html/1706.08840v6, gradient projection method and abstract
papers.mechanism: Projects gradients using constraints derived from episodic memory.
papers.demonstrated_scope: MNIST variants and CIFAR-100 task sequences; transfer metrics.
papers.cdm_relevance: Supplies a retention baseline and explicit transfer measurements.

papers.title: Model-Agnostic Meta-Learning for Fast Adaptation of Deep Networks
papers.mechanism: Trains parameter initialization for effective adaptation after few gradient steps.
papers.demonstrated_scope: Few-shot classification, regression, and policy-gradient adaptation.
papers.cdm_relevance: A baseline for preparing model parameters to learn from future experience.

papers.title: Experience Replay for Continual Learning
papers.mechanism: Combines replay, on/off-policy updates, and behavioral cloning.
papers.demonstrated_scope: Continual Atari and DMLab without supplied task boundaries.
papers.cdm_relevance: Strong baseline for retaining control abilities during ongoing learning.

papers.title: Loss of plasticity in deep continual learning
papers.evidence_location: https://github.com/shibhansh/loss-of-plasticity, abstract and citation; author spelling cross-checked against arXiv:2306.13812
papers.mechanism: Continual backpropagation renews a fraction of low-utility units.
papers.demonstrated_scope: Continual ImageNet-derived classification and reinforcement-learning experiments.
papers.cdm_relevance: Track the ability to acquire new skills after extensive prior training.

papers.title: Titans: Learning to Memorize at Test Time
papers.mechanism: Combines attention with test-time learning in neural memory.
papers.demonstrated_scope: Language, commonsense reasoning, genomics, time series, and long-context retrieval.
papers.cdm_relevance: Close prior art for attention coupled to persistent trainable memory.

papers.title: Learning to (Learn at Test Time): RNNs with Expressive Hidden States
papers.mechanism: A learned model is the recurrent state; self-supervision updates it.
papers.demonstrated_scope: Language models from 125M to 1.3B parameters.
papers.cdm_relevance: Direct precedent for fast-parameter memory in a recurrent backbone.

papers.title: ATLAS: Learning to Optimally Memorize the Context at Test Time
papers.mechanism: Optimizes neural memory using current and past context.
papers.demonstrated_scope: Language modeling, reasoning, recall, and long-context understanding.
papers.cdm_relevance: Accumulated-evidence memory optimization is established prior work.

papers.title: Mitigating Plasticity Loss in Continual Reinforcement Learning by Reducing Churn
papers.mechanism: Reduces update-induced variability on out-of-batch outputs.
papers.demonstrated_scope: Continual Gym control, ProcGen, DeepMind Control, and MinAtar.
papers.cdm_relevance: Continual-RL plasticity comparator beyond retention-only methods.

papers.title: It's All Connected: A Journey Through Test-Time Memorization, Attentional Bias, Retention, and Online Optimization
papers.mechanism: Framework over associative representation, memory objective, retention, and update algorithm.
papers.demonstrated_scope: Language, commonsense reasoning, and recall-intensive tasks.
papers.cdm_relevance: Organizes the update-rule design space CDM must compare against.

papers.title: Nested Learning: The Illusion of Deep Learning Architectures
papers.mechanism: Combines self-modifying memory and parameter blocks with different update frequencies.
papers.demonstrated_scope: Language modeling, long-context tasks, and class-incremental text classification.
papers.cdm_relevance: Close precedent for multilevel learning and persistent adaptive memory.

papers.title: Self-Adapting Language Models
papers.mechanism: Generates finetuning data and directives, trained through post-update performance.
papers.demonstrated_scope: Knowledge incorporation and few-shot generalization.
papers.cdm_relevance: Self-directed parameter adaptation is already a concrete research line.

papers.title: End-to-End Test-Time Training for Long Context
papers.mechanism: Meta-trains initialization for runtime next-token updates in selected Transformer MLPs.
papers.demonstrated_scope: Language-model scaling, retrieval, and inference efficiency.
papers.cdm_relevance: Important standard-backbone alternative to architectural memory novelty.

papers.title: Continuous Memory Machines
papers.mechanism: Shared Transformer updates distinct short- and long-term matrix states.
papers.demonstrated_scope: Algorithmic tasks, maze reasoning, few-shot regression, and ImageNet-100.
papers.cdm_relevance: Direct neighbor of two-store persistent computation; requires explicit differentiation.

papers.title: Meta-TTL: Meta-Learning Self-Improvement Policies for Language Agents
papers.mechanism: Meta-trains policies for improvement across repeated agent interactions.
papers.demonstrated_scope: Language-agent benchmarks including Jericho and WebArena-Lite, with held-out tasks.
papers.cdm_relevance: Comparator for learning how to improve rather than hand-coding adaptation.

papers.title: Unsupervised Predictive Memory in a Goal-Directed Agent
papers.mechanism: Predictive modelling guides memory formation.
papers.demonstrated_scope: Partially observable 3D virtual tasks requiring long memories.
papers.cdm_relevance: Training useful state rather than adding memory capacity.

papers.title: World Models
papers.evidence_location: Author-maintained interactive paper, model components and controller sections: https://worldmodels.github.io/
